issues.display_title: Issue #26: Update Auto Complete Search Map Location
issues.main_description_html:
Integrate API Auto Complete Search Location (https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/20102216/2s946o4UYn#1d6f5245-7a57-4f80-b7e7-58107e682d7b)

🧪 QA Tester Summary — Issue #26: Update Auto Complete Search Map Location

Wiki feature: #9 Encrypted Search Suite: qa_testing/e2e/module/search/autocomplete-search.spec.ts (Playwright · Chromium · headed) Env: Production https://maps.gothru.co/ · live Auto Complete Search Location API Result: 4 / 4 scenarios PASSED

✅ Test Scenario & Result

#TypeWhat the test verifies (user scenario)Result
1UI / Layout (White Box)Ensures the search box opens and shows a suggestion dropdown the moment the user starts typing a location.✅ Pass
2Functional / Integration (Gray Box)Ensures typing a place name fetches matching locations from the Auto Complete API and shows up to 5 suggestions.✅ Pass
3Validation (Black Box)Ensures the suggested locations are relevant to what was typed, and refine correctly as more letters are added.✅ Pass
4Acceptance · Task Sprint (Black Box)Ensures the full flow works: open the map → type a location → the auto-complete suggestions appear, ready to pick.✅ Pass

Verified live against the search backend: typing "london" returns 5 relevant London, UK predictions in the dropdown, each with the typed term highlighted, capped at the app's 5-result limit.

Task Sprint tags: @regression @passed @task_sprint @viewer @#search (All scenarios passed → @bug / @sanity_test / @solved / @fixed omitted.)

🔌 Backend & Review

Flow: typing debounces (~500ms) → search(query) → apip:get:search?q=:q&app_name=gothru-maps → encrypted predictions decrypted client-side → rendered as the suggestion list.

Backend callHTTPFrontend outcomeReview
GET search?q=…&app_name=gothru-maps200predictions decrypted → suggestion dropdown✅ Verified
Empty / no predictions200dropdown hidden (no stale suggestions)✅ Verified

🔍 Code Review

Source: src/components/search/InputSearch.tsx, src/data/layer/search.ts

  • Input is debounced (~500ms) before hitting the API, so the autocomplete fires once per pause, not per keystroke. ✅
  • API predictions are sliced to 5 and the typed words wrapped in <b> (relevance highlight). ✅
  • Picking a suggestion (click / Enter) flies the map to its lat/lng and writes the place name into the bar. ✅
  • No defects found for the auto-complete search flow.

🐞 Bug notes

  • None found for the core flow.

issues.display_title: Issue #22: Change Dots Marker Image to Blue Line for Blue Line Tour
issues.main_description_html:

Wiki feature: #1 Moderation Map (tour rendering) Suite: qa_testing/e2e/module/maps/blue-line.spec.ts (Playwright · Chromium · headed) Env: Production https://maps.gothru.co/ZhFxiX0RLYszj0IKQKN2 ("576 E Shore Rd to 47 E Shore Rd") Result: 4 / 4 scenarios PASSED

✅ Test Scenario & Result

#TypeWhat the test verifies (user scenario)Result
1UI / Layout (White Box)Ensures the tour map opens and renders.✅ Pass
2Functional / Integration (Gray Box)Ensures the blue tour colour is actually painted on the map.✅ Pass
3Validation (Black Box)Ensures the tour shows as a connected blue line, not scattered dots.✅ Pass

Verified two ways so a line can't be confused with dots (both share the colour #6366f1): 3,732 blue pixels painted on the map and 48 LineString features decoded from the loaded map tiles (vs 4,840 point dots). The screenshot/video are captured only after the blue line is confirmed on screen.

issues.display_title: Issue #30: Implement Double Click to Open Tour in New Tab
issues.main_description_html:
Implement functionality that allows users to double-click on a tour map, which opens the respective tour in a new browser tab. This will help in cases where a user is on one tour (e.g., XX1) and wants to view another tour (e.g., XX3) without losing their current session

🧪 QA Tester Summary — Issue #30: Implement Double Click to Open Tour in New Tab

Wiki feature: #1 Moderation Map (tour interaction) Suite: qa_testing/e2e/module/maps/open-tour.spec.ts (Playwright · Chromium · headed) Env: Production https://maps.gothru.co/ZhFxiX0RLYszj0IKQKN2 ("576 E Shore Rd to 47 E Shore Rd") Result: 4 / 4 scenarios PASSED

✅ Test Scenario & Result

#TypeWhat the test verifies (user scenario)Result
1UI / Layout (White Box)Ensures the map opens and the blue tour line is shown.✅ Pass
2Functional / Integration (Gray Box)Ensures double-clicking the line opens a new browser tab.✅ Pass
3Validation (Black Box)Ensures the new tab opens the correct tour (tourmkr.com).✅ Pass
4Acceptance · Task Sprint (Black Box)Ensures: open the map → wait for the blue line → double-click the line → a new tab opens to the tour.✅ Pass

Verified end-to-end: the blue line is located by its #6366f1 pixels on the map, double-clicked, and the resulting new browser tab navigates to the tour — e.g. https://tourmkr.com/F1dRCxesv6/42737345p. This lets a user open another tour without losing their current session.

Task Sprint tags: @regression @passed @task_sprint @viewer @#moderation_map (All scenarios passed → @bug / @sanity_test / @solved / @fixed omitted.)

🔍 Code Review

Source: src/components/main/maps/source/moderations/ModerationMapEvents.tsx

  • map.on('dblclick', …Lines/…Cirlces, handleDoubleClick) → for a line feature openTourLines(tourKey, nearestPanoId) → window.open('https://tourmkr.com/F1{tourKey}/{panoId}p', '_blank'). ✅
  • Double-click preventDefault()s the map's default zoom so the gesture is dedicated to opening the tour. ✅
  • The nearest pano on the line is chosen from the clicked point, so the opened tour starts near where the user clicked. ✅
  • No defects found for the double-click-to-new-tab flow.

🐞 Bug notes

  • None found for the core flow.

The video uses the fullscreen-window (address-bar) recording mode so the tested URL is visible in the browser bar.
